sentences.text: Roseburia faecis is a butyrate-producing, Gram-positive anaerobic bacterium found in the human gut.
A complete genome sequence is available for its type strain M72/1.
That strain metabolises plant beta-mannans, including carob galactomannan, konjac glucomannan and acetylated spruce galactoglucomannan.
In adults, its abundance rose together with other commensals after consumption of water kefir.
One study reported a substantial decline in Roseburia faecis after Helicobacter pylori eradication, interpreted as disruption of butyrate-producing bacteria.
